choices.text: Neutral: polite greeting, softened request, standard closing
Informal: friendly greeting, direct request, casual closing
Formal: official opening, long request, traditional closing

choices.text: Informal: friendly and relaxed, with casual phrasing.
Formal: polite and official, like a letter to a company.

A colleague, in a neutral and friendly way.

feedback.es: Good afternoon, regarding, unfortunately y I would be grateful son marcas formales propias de quien se dirige a una empresa.

Calm about whether she is ever paid.

feedback.es: Recuerda que prometieron pagar en diez días y fija un plazo (by Friday): es cortés, pero deja clara su impaciencia.

Its apology is excessive for such a small delay.

That she wants the essay marked without changes.

es: Diagnosticar por qué un mensaje suena brusco, frío o excesivamente rígido y elegir la corrección con marcadores de cortesía y directividad adecuada.

vocabulary.es: decir las cosas sin rodeos ni suavizar

teaching.en: Tom's message was blunt because he likes to pull no punches: «Give me the file today» is an order with no polite marker, and it can sound abrupt to a busy colleague.
teaching.es: El mensaje de Tom era brusco porque no se anda con rodeos: «Give me the file today» es una orden sin ningún marcador de cortesía y puede sonar seco a un compañero ocupado.
teaching.explanationEs: Blunt: una orden directa, sin marcadores de cortesía. Pull no punches es decir las cosas sin suavizarlas; sound abrupt describe el efecto en quien lo lee.
segments: Tom's message was blunt because he likes to pull no punches: «Give me the file today»
is an order with no polite marker, and it can sound abrupt to a busy colleague.
teaching.audioText: Tom's message was blunt because he likes to pull no punches: «Give me the file today» is an order with no polite marker, and it can sound abrupt to a busy colleague.

teaching.en: Could you send me the file when you can? I would appreciate it, especially if at all possible before lunch.

teaching.explanationEs: Could you + I would appreciate it: la petición ya suena cortés. If at all possible deja margen al otro.

teaching.explanationEs: Would you mind + -ing: petición indirecta y educada. Walk on eggshells es moverse con extremo cuidado para no molestar.

prompt.es: Escucha esta reclamación y elige el diagnóstico de su tono.

choices.text: Stiff: too official for the situation.
Blunt and angry: orders without any polite marker.
Firm but polite: clear facts with a polite request.

feedback.es: Dos órdenes secas y un reproche sin marcadores de cortesía forman un mensaje brusco; habría que suavizarlo con could y una petición concreta.

origin.audio: Right, listen. Your oven arrived two weeks late, and now it doesn't work. I've called three times and nobody has answered. Give me my money back now. I will not wait any longer, and I will not repeat myself.

prompt.es: ¿Qué respuesta de la empresa incluye disculpa, solución y plazo?

choices.text: Thank you for writing. We are looking into it and will reply as soon as we can.
We apologise for the inconvenience. We will make sure this does not happen again.
We apologise for the inconvenience. We will send a replacement by Friday.

feedback.es: La buena respuesta pide disculpas, ofrece una solución concreta y fija una fecha; las otras dos se quedan en promesas sin solución ni plazo.

origin.text: Customer message: «My replacement oven has not arrived, and I expect you to resolve this.»

prompt.es: Completa: «Estamos dispuestos a ofrecerle alguna compensación por el retraso.»

feedback.es: Some form of compensation es la colocación para reparar el daño causado con dinero o una ventaja.

origin.text: We know the delivery fell short of what you expected, so we are prepared to offer some form of ___ for the delay.

prompt.es: Escribe la respuesta breve de la empresa a la reclamación de Carlos.

answer.text: Dear Mr Ruiz, thank you for your message, and please accept our apologies for the inconvenience. We will send a replacement oven by Friday, and we will offer you compensation for the delay, which fell short of the standard we aim for. Please contact us if you need any further assistance. Kind regards, Customer Service
accepted: Dear Mr Ruiz, thank you for your message, and please accept our apologies for the inconvenience. We will send a replacement oven by Friday, and we will offer you compensation for the delay, which fell short of the standard we aim for. Please contact us if you need any further assistance. Kind regards, Customer Service

Dear Mr Ruiz, thank you for contacting us. We apologise for the delay and for the faulty oven, which fell short of our usual standard. A replacement will be sent before Friday, and we will also offer you compensation. Kind regards, Customer Service

feedback.es: La respuesta agradece, se disculpa, da una solución con plazo y cierra con cortesía en el mismo registro formal.

origin.text: Responde como la empresa: agradece el mensaje, pide disculpas, ofrece un horno nuevo antes del viernes y una compensación, y cierra con un saludo formal.
